verdict.rationale: Cognee's core design explicitly builds a knowledge graph by extracting entities and relationships from ingested data (.remember/.improve), supports ontology-based canonical entity linking, and .recall performs graph-based multi-hop retrieval; founders also cite HotpotQA multi-hop benchmark results (87%) as evidence of entity-centric/multi-hop QA capability. missing for 10: independent (non-founder) benchmark verification of multi-hop accuracy, and clearer documentation of relationship-traversal mechanics beyond founder claims and marketing docs.
